text: No, I don't want to use my Visa. And I don't have a gift card. Like I said, that's not what I asked. I just want the 500ml one refunded. Can't you just do that? I don't want to cancel the whole order, just the bottle.
zh: 不，我不想用我的Visa卡。而且我没有礼品卡。就像我说的，那不是我要的。我只想退回500毫升的那个。你不能直接这样做吗？我不想取消整个订单，只是这个瓶子。
